criteria.reason: Copy Last and Done always appear, but Next is omitted when the keypad is opened for reps.
Done is one button in a shared three-button flex row rather than full width.
Buttons have 14px vertical padding, but no explicit minimum height guarantees the 44px target.
Copy Last uses the supplied previousValue for the same field and updates the display and value.
Next changes the keypad state from weight to reps, but NumericKeypad does not sync its display when the value prop changes.
The button styles use color and radius tokens, but Done still uses a hardcoded white text color.
The flex row can shrink to fit narrow mobile widths and no breakpoint is required for the layout.
Button labels contain no exclamation marks or hype.
Harness results show all server and client tests passed.
New tests cover Copy Last behavior, its disabled state, and Next.
